observationsNotFindings: basedOn.d278.role names D-278 as last heading only. D-278 is 'Record g16 leftover-join.v5', an unrelated gate family. The subject correctly draws no G10 authority from it. Custody-only, as required.

The subject's OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH reason quotes occupancy v2's proposedLaterWork closely. This is faithful citation of an existing artifact's own deferral, not the minting of a new one — occupancy v2 already carries that sentence, and the subject performs no refresh.

predecessorV3.role contains the token 'v4', but only as the subject's self-reference ('This v4 remasures…'). The role explicitly disclaims the version number for the predecessor in its closing sentence. Not a speaker-label defect.

occupancy v2's own proposedLaterWork already records that 'provider leftover-join.v3 already remasured leftover-design remaining on G10 as OBL-G10-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH. This file does not flip leftoverDesign.' v4 preserving that exact pair is corroborated from the occupancy side as well as the v3 side.
The two leftover-true obligations both carry executionObligationOwnerToday 'none', consistent with a not-capable-of-riding remainder; no owner is invented for work that has none.

The subject is a genuine remeasurement of leftover-join.v3 at HEAD 7ba3615 that swaps the stale occupancy v1 citation for occupancy v2 (D-212) while preserving the obligation set, the leftoverDesign pair, the HARD-BLOCKED token and required-now 28 exactly.
